name: Indian Overseas Bank
title: Indian Overseas Bank - 532388 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Advances up 24.16% to Rs 3,10,423 crore and net profit up 56% to ~Rs 5,208 crore, with GNPA down to 1.42%; management guides 14-16% industry credit growth and NIM 3.30-3.35%, but no supply-side lever applies to a bank.

triggers.label: NIM guided 3.30-3.35%
triggers.quote: We expect to maintain at this range between 3.30 to 3.35.

triggers.label: Advances +24.16% YoY
triggers.quote: Regarding total advances, there is an increase of 24.16% year -on-year basis

triggers.label: ECL front-loading >3000 cr
triggers.quote: the total impact of ECL, the new guideline which has been given by the regulator, it is going to be around 3000 crores

triggers.label: Treasury gains muted next two quarters
triggers.quote: We do not see, I will say, huge gain from treasury for next two quarters

guidance.quote: we do hope that 14 % to 15% to 16% growth for overall industry, not only for IOB, is very much feasible
We expect to maintain at this range between 3.30 to 3.35.
So, this year we are targeting around 3600 crores of recovery.

guidance.value: front-load >3000 crore total, 1750 crore already held
guidance.quote: by the time 1st April '27 comes, I think we will be having a cushion in the name of ECL itself, more than 3000 crores

prior_guidance_check.quote: we grew by 24% in credit and 18% in deposit

red_flags.label: Overseas legacy NPAs one-third of NPA
red_flags.quote: these NP accounts in overseas center, they are legacy accounts very old ones

red_flags.label: Govt-linked tax demands Rs 4,832 cr
red_flags.quote: Last three years t here has been a demand of 4832 crores pertaining to previous assessment years

red_flags.label: Management cites SMA as 4.92% without full disclosure in deck
red_flags.quote: the SMA numbers have not been disclosed

evasions.quote: Why I should be going for those type of corporate loans where margin is not there?
That creating a float in the system, that is a challenge, and we are working on it.
